def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()

    if isinstance(value, F):
        return str(value)
    raise TypeError(type(value).__name__)

    check("existing family upper scale", xmax == F(16, 39))
    corrected = []
    for index, row in enumerate(family["ledger"]):
        x = F(row["scale"])
        total_rate = F(row["total_rate"])
        gamma = list(map(F, row["gamma_rates"]))
        ic = list(map(F, row["ic_rates"]))
        residual = list(map(F, row["residual_non_gamma_rates"]))
        branch_absolute = [gamma[i] / total_rate for i in range(2)]
        global_absolute = sum(gamma) / total_rate
        check(f"row {index} parent total normalized", total_rate == 1 and sum(gamma + ic + residual) == 1)
        check(f"row {index} gamma scope per branch", gamma == [x / 4, 3 * x / 4])
        check(f"row {index} true target absolute branches", branch_absolute == [x / 4, 3 * x / 4])
        check(f"row {index} global radiative sum", global_absolute == x)
        check(f"row {index} old ambiguous label is global sum", F(row["b_rad"]) == global_absolute)
        check(f"row {index} old label differs from both targets", all(F(row["b_rad"]) != value for value in branch_absolute))
        check(f"row {index} positive synthetic IC retained", ic == [alpha[i] * gamma[i] for i in range(2)]
              and all(value > 0 for value in ic))
        check(f"row {index} ledger stays nonnegative", 0 < x <= xmax and min(gamma + ic + residual) >= 0)
        check(f"row {index} total pair branches unchanged", [gamma[i] + ic[i] + residual[i] for i in range(2)] == b_pair)
        check(f"row {index} photon normalized fractions unchanged", [gamma[i] / sum(gamma) for i in range(2)] == f)
        check(f"row {index} global to target factor 4 and 4/3",
              global_absolute / branch_absolute[0] == 4 and global_absolute / branch_absolute[1] == F(4, 3))
        corrected.append({
            "x": x, "parent_total_rate_over_lambda_ref": total_rate,
            "gamma_rates_over_lambda_ref": gamma,
            "b_rad_each_target_pair": branch_absolute, "b_rad_sum_all_photons": global_absolute,
            "Gamma_gamma_each_target_over_Gamma_ref": [x * f[i] for i in range(2)],
            "Gamma_gamma_sum_over_Gamma_ref": x,
            "ic_rates_over_lambda_ref": ic, "residual_non_gamma_rates_over_lambda_ref": residual,
            "total_pair_branches": b_pair, "photon_normalized_intensities": f,
        })

    # Recheck the producer's correctly scoped family; this is not a new case.
    for index, row in enumerate(producer["unknown_E0_failure_family"]["exact_controls"]):
        target_gamma = F(row["Gamma_pair_gamma"])
        other_gamma = F(row["Gamma_other_gamma"])
        pair_non_gamma = F(row["Gamma_pair_E0_electrons"])
        other_non_gamma = F(row["Gamma_other_nongamma"])
        parent_total = target_gamma + other_gamma + pair_non_gamma + other_non_gamma
        check(f"producer row {index} target photon and global sum distinct",
              parent_total == 1 and target_gamma / parent_total == target_gamma
              and (target_gamma + other_gamma) / parent_total == 2 * target_gamma)
        check(f"producer row {index} epsilon retains target denominator",
              F(row["omitted_pair_gamma"]) / target_gamma == F(row["epsilon_actual"]) == F(1, 2))

    for relative, expected in protected.items():
        check("frozen bytes unchanged after clarification " + relative,
              sha((ROOT / relative).read_bytes()) == expected)
    code = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    return {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "artifact_kind": "Day8-independent-review-supplement-photon-inventory-scope-clarification",
        "status": "confirmed-material-documentation-finding; corrected-per-branch-interpretation",

        },

        "unchanged_counterfamily_proof": {

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--write-receipt", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--verify-saved", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.write_receipt and args.verify_saved:
        parser.error("Receipt creation and saved-receipt verification are separate operations")
    report = build()
    if args.verify_saved:
        saved = json.loads((ROOT / OUT).read_bytes())
        normalized = json.loads(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, default=encoded))
        if saved != normalized:
            raise AssertionError("Default recomputation differs from saved scope clarification")
    if args.write_receipt:
        with (ROOT / OUT).open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
            json.dump(report, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=encoded)
            stream.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=encoded))
